Pixel OS v2.1.4 — Pure Retail Google PixelOS Stable Update for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Dual EXT4 + F2FS /data Support Out of the Box & Clean-Flash Bootloader-Loop Fix: restored native F2FS + EXT4 /data mounting in /vendor/etc/fstab.qcom (fixing reboot-to-bootloader on TWRP 3.7.0_12-0 when Format Data formats userdata as F2FS), added clean /metadata ext4 formatting & matched Flags=3 vbmeta.img in VendorBoot.zip, and added pre-flight install-order & package-type guards (E1000 / E1002)
• Compact Wireless Patch OTA (~40 MiB — no 1.81 GB full system re-download required!)
• Fixed Websites Not Opening in Chrome, Brave & Chromium Browsers: stripped Qualcomm vendor init.target.rc 'stop statsd' and hardened zygote_next's native species library (libzygote_species_android_native.so)
• Out-of-the-Box 4K 60fps & 1080p 60fps Hardware Gyro-EIS3 Video Stabilization: patched Qualcomm Spectra 380 CHI HAL (UsecaseVideo4kEIS3PreviewEIS2 + stream-order-independent binder) & pre-seeded Pixel 9 GCam 9.6 custom EIS sessions (32808 60fps / 32779 30fps)
• 100% Pure Google PixelOS Experience on Default Stable Channel + Opt-In 'iOS Style UI Beta' Toggle in Settings -> System -> System update
